title.narrative: Supporting policy makers and sports practitioners drive equality and tackle gender-based violence in and through sport

description.narrative: In the framework of Fit for Life implementation, the Sport Section will support policy makers and sports practitioners design and deliver inclusive sport policies and programmes that empower girls and women from all backgrounds, and tackle gender-based violence. The Sport Section will launch the Fit for Life Sport and Gender Equality Game Plan, a practical toolkit designed to support decisionmakers implement gender equality commitments and measure both progress in this regard, as well as the return on investments. As part of this work, the Sport Section will mobilize Member States and members of the Fit for Life Global Alliance to promote and adopt the recommendations of the UNESCO-UN Women ‘Handbook on Tackling Violence Against Women and Girls in Sport’, through advocacy campaigns, events, knowledge exchange and coalition-building. Implementation of both the Game Plan and the Handbook will be supported through pilot projects in countries and cities in a later phase, with a special focus on impact measurement and participatory policy-making.
